episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her strategy for leveraging YouTube as a cornerstone of a real estate marketing plan. She explains how to repurpose video content into blog posts using AI tools, enhancing visibility across Google and AI search platforms. The episode provides actionable insights on creating client-focused content that answers real questions, building a comprehensive library of resources that continue to generate leads over time.
